meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Rakuten Ichiba (rakuten.co.jp): hide billboard ads, promo banners and survey/app promos; dim or hide recommendations; item picture choice.
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, headless Chrome over CDP with a desktop UA (1440x900) on www.rakuten.co.jp/ (the Ichiba top page). Not captured: an iPhone-UA page (Rakuten redirects phones to a separate mobile site, and Chrome/network were out of memory when retried), item, shop and search pages, the logged-in top page.

LIVE counts on the top page: billboard-ad desktop home 3; promo-banners desktop home 4; survey-app desktop home 2; recs-dim desktop home 7; recs-hide desktop home 7; pictures-blur desktop home 1460; pictures-hide desktop home 1460; history-widgets desktop home 4; deal-widgets desktop home 3. Selectors are `irc="..."` widget attributes, the ids `#runa_Billboard_Wrapper`, `#bigBannerWidget`, `#raceWidget` and the readable `globalBannerWrapper` class; the page's `--3Ggnq`-style hashed classes are not used. Text is Japanese and no rule matches text.

Choices: Recommendations and ranking Show/Dim/Hide (opacity 0.35); Item pictures Show/Blur/Hide (blur 12px, also catches banner pictures). Search (`SearchWidget`), the header and the side navigation stay.

NOT verified: phone site, search results (which carry Rakuten Ads cards), item pages, signed-in widgets, whether widget names change between top-page experiments.
